_about: The test DIMENSIONS: every axis whose value could change how the app behaves. Transcribed from the QA-TESTDIM1 registry (dimensions.html) into structured form so test classes can reference them and generators can derive instances. 'boundaries' = the turning-point values where bugs historically cluster — always included in derived sets.

dimensions.name: Device / input
dimensions.notes: touch-drag vs mouse-drag vs tap-to-offer paths differ; known device-dependent snags live here

dimensions.name: Network
dimensions.notes: playnet: no WC, manual labels only; mainnet: real-value guard rails

dimensions.name: Chip layout 🧪
dimensions.notes: both live until the desktop verdict (BOARD-LAYOUT1); sticky added 2026-07-16 (BOARD-ARRANGE1 slice 1)

dimensions.name: Net view 🧪
dimensions.notes: on is standard; off is the escape hatch; withdraw-all only applies when on

dimensions.name: Account source
dimensions.notes: profile WC list vs game accounts are separate stores (KAT-ACCTNORM1)

dimensions.name: Accounts per player
dimensions.notes: wheel windowing + divider wedges engage past the cap; 2+ enables own→own transfers

dimensions.name: Players on board
dimensions.notes: segment angle obtuse→acute changes physics; crossing maxSegments changes DOM (wedge dividers); party/cluster semantics need ≥3

dimensions.name: Aspect / orientation
dimensions.notes: square≈circle HID the circular-walls bug for weeks; extremes stress the safe rect. Added as its own dimension 2026-07-16 (was folded into board-motion resize)

dimensions.name: Asset kind
dimensions.notes: unknown-decimals guard = AMOUNT-SCALE1 incident; NFT has no pile (different choreography)

dimensions.name: Board motion state
dimensions.notes: lines must track chips through every motion (live trails, 2026-07-16); chips must not jump

dimensions.name: Settings matrix
dimensions.notes: skin, net, self-bottom, max-on-ring, anim speed, trail after-glow, chip layout, party-only, pickable, zone-walls, hug-ring, sticky

dimensions.name: Signing outcome
dimensions.notes: expiry verdict is signal-driven (backend resolve broadcast); 🟩/🟥 banner

dimensions.name: Connection health
dimensions.notes: add-account late-land (30s+60s poll) lives here; 7-July zombie incident was slow-mirror at restart
